page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with the printed page number at top right and the running head at top left. A rule divides the upper part from the lower section. A final signature mark sits at the lower right. No notes in the margins.

main_text.p: Libertinorum status tripertitus antea fuer[?]t. Nam qui manumittebantur, modò majorem & justam libertatem consequebantur & fiebant cives Romani: Modò minorem & Latini ex lege Julia Norbana fiebant: Modo inferiorem: & fiebant ex lege Aelia Sentia Dediticii. §.libertinorum.inst.eod.

Hodie vero est unum tantum genus libertinorum, qui fiunt cives Romani: Reliqua duo genera Imperator duabus Constitutionibus sustulit.l.cùm dediticii. C.de Latin.libert.tollend.& l.deditilia[?]. C.de deditilia liber.tollend.
main_text.head: QUIS EST SEXTUS Titulus?
Quibus ex causis manumittere non licet. Auß was vrsachen nicht zugelassen wirt loß zugeben.
main_text.p: NOn tamen cuicunque volenti, manumittere licet. Nam is qui in fraudem creditorum manumittit, nihil agit: quia lex Aelia Sentia impedit libertatem. in princ.inst.eod.

head.i: Potestne Dominus, qui solvendo non est, in testamento manumittere?

main_text.p: Licet Domino qui solvendo non est, in testamento servum suum cum libertate haeredem instituere, ut liber fiat, haeresque ei solus & necessarius: si modò ei nemo alius ex eo testamento haeres extiterit. §. licet.inst.eod.

page.notes: The "u" in "fuerat" is partly obscured by a blot; read as "fuer[?]t" with the letter unclear. "deditilia" in the second paragraph is not clear; the word may read "deditia" or similar. The page number 433 is printed at top right and is partly faint. The black letter German line is set in a different type and was copied as printed. The signature "E" is at the lower right.
